intent: Monochrome slide-over cart that choreographs every open: blocks rise from blur, line items stagger, the free-shipping meter fills after landing and the totals count up; undo lives in place; a bottom sheet on phones.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useMotionValue, useTransform, useVelocity, animate, AnimatePresence, useDragControls)

layout.desktop: 440px right panel, full height, scrim black/60 with 2px blur
layout.mobile: bottom sheet from top 12px, 22px top radius, 40x4 drag handle
sections: free-shipping card with track, fill and riding truck disc
footer: subtotal/shipping dl + 56px checkout pill with total capsule + reassurance line
layout.item: 72x84 thumbnail, name/variant left, line price right, stepper + Remove along the bottom
layout.demoStage: only the bar the trigger lives in, on #08080a; nothing behind the drawer

color.accent: #d7e3a4 via the accent prop: the total capsule on the checkout button only, with #0b0b0c text
color.everythingElse: ink at opacities: trigger badge, meter fill, unlocked check, Free, Pairs well, Undo pill, drain line
color.products: thumbnails use each product's own colour (depicted)

motion.timeline: T (s) from the panel starting: header 0.12, shipping card 0.17, items 0.22 + 0.06 each, footer 0.3, meter fill 0.36, counts 0.4 (600ms), upsell 0.42
motion.panel: spring 340/36 from the right (bottom on phones); exit stiffer; scrim fades 300ms
motion.meter: one motion value drives fill width and truck position; fills from 0 after the card lands, then springs 120/20 on changes; truck wiggles once on unlock
motion.figures: Money component: motion value + useTransform text + velocity blur; subtotal and checkout total count from 0; prices tween 350ms on change
motion.rows: added rows (after the panel settles) grow from height 0 and rise in; removed rows collapse 300ms; quantities roll 14px in the direction of change
motion.undo: 2px ink/50 line drains over undoSeconds via a motion value; hover/focus pauses and resumes from where it stopped
motion.sheet: drag only from the handle; dismiss past 140px or 700px/s
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades, figures set instantly, no drag

responsive.mobile: bottom sheet, 44px touch targets, safe-area bottom padding
responsive.store: demo store grid 2 cols -> 4 cols at md

accessibility: role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the shipping status
focus moves to the dialog, Tab is trapped, Esc and scrim close, focus returns to the trigger
steppers are labelled groups; the minus at qty 1 reads 'Remove …'
polite live region for quantity, remove and restore
shipping bar is a progressbar with values

items: Waxed field notebook — A5 · Olive · Dot grid — £18 × 2
Merino trail socks — Rust · Size M — £14
content.upsell: Brass bullet pencil — Lives in the notebook’s spine. — £12

avoid: a fake storefront, nav or headline behind the drawer
lime on badges, meters, labels or undo
product photos or grey placeholder boxes
gradient checkout button or scarcity pressure
per-frame React state for counting figures
